description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Credit Bureau functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It sets up mocked external services, configures credit bureau settings, and verifies the retrieval and correctness of credit reports including handling cases with and without active loans.

classes.name: CreditBureauTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying the integration of credit bureau services within Fineract, including setup and response validation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test setup, configures REST specifications, and calls credit bureau configuration.

methods.name: configureCreditBureauService
methods.description: Configures credit bureau settings, including credentials and URLs, for testing purposes.

methods.name: creditBureauIntegrationTest
methods.description: Tests the credit bureau report retrieval with mocked responses, verifying data correctness.

methods.name: creditBureauNoLoanTest
methods.description: Tests the case where the credit report indicates no active or write-off loans.
